{{Top|leg}}
A '''MechMiner''' was a small tracked vehicle designed for [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. The operator controlled the MechMiner from a single seat, controlling a variety of mining tools. Using a MechMiner allowed a single miner to do the work of a dozen beings. MechMiners were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Akin-Dower]] produced a model designated as the [[Mechanized Autominer Mk IV]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
